models.notes: High-throughput, low-latency, cost-efficient TTS model for conversational voice and production workloads. Stable Gemini API model released 2026-09-22 with no shutdown date announced. Official input and output token limits are 8,192 and 16,384. Supports Batch API, Flex inference, and Priority inference. Context caching is not supported: the model page says so since its 2026-10-09 update, and the pricing page dropped the cached-input and cache-storage rates between 2026-10-08 and 2026-10-09 without a published effective date. Current prices are effective through 2026-12-31; separately stored future records take effect 2027-01-01. Audio output is 25 tokens per second. The legacy V1 output scalar remains null because the published output price is for audio tokens, not text tokens.
